items_flat.title_en: Anthropic introduces Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 for demanding technical work
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2，專為高難度技術工作設計
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 on Nov 9 as upgraded models for the most ambitious open-ended technical challenges. They share an underlying model; Fable carries stronger cybersecurity and biology safeguards for general availability, while Mythos is restricted to verified organizations via Cyber and Life Sciences programs. Pricing dropped 20% to $8/M input and $40/M output (fast mode up to 2.5× speed at double price); outputs are up to 30% faster, with a 1M-token context window.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 11 月 9 日宣布 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2，專為最具雄心的開放式技術挑戰升級。兩者共用底層模型；Fable 具備較強網路安全與生物防護以供一般使用，Mythos 則僅限經 Cyber 與生命科學驗證計畫的組織。定價降 20% 至輸入每百萬 $8、輸出 $40（快速模式最高 2.5 倍速、雙倍價格）；輸出速度最高提升 30%，並支援 100 萬 token 上下文。
items_flat.analysis_en: The dual-configuration approach lets Anthropic broaden access while retaining restricted high-capability variants for verified cyber and life-sciences work. Reported gains on coding, science, and agent benchmarks plus the price cut strengthen its position for hard technical workloads, though independent long-horizon reliability and safety residual risks remain to be verified in production.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 雙配置設計讓 Anthropic 擴大可及性，同時保留經驗證的高能力變體給資安與生命科學用途。程式、科學與代理基準的進步加上降價，強化其在高難度技術工作的競爭力，但獨立長程可靠性與殘餘安全風險仍待實際部署驗證。
items_flat.quote: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2 在程式設計、推理與視覺等方面展現改進。

items_flat.title_en: Meta introduces Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model for agent workflows
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Ember，專為代理工作流程設計的最小且最高效模型
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced Muse Ember on Nov 9 as its smallest multimodal model built for high-volume agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing and document parsing. It offers a 1M-token context window, is priced at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens, and is available on the Meta Model API, Muse Code, and now Google Cloud. Meta positions it as matching Claude Haiku 5.5's best Intelligence Index score at roughly one-third the cost per task.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 於 11 月 9 日宣布 Muse Ember，這是其最小的多模態模型，專為高容量代理工作（工具呼叫、程式子任務、路由與文件解析）打造。具備 100 萬 token 上下文，定價為輸入每百萬 $0.10、輸出 $0.50，可於 Meta Model API、Muse Code 及現已上架 Google Cloud 使用。Meta 稱其在 Intelligence Index 上與 Claude Haiku 5.5 最佳分數相當，但每任務成本約為三分之一。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ember targets the repetitive sub-steps that dominate agent token usage, potentially lowering the cost of multi-agent systems when paired with larger Muse models. Benchmark claims versus Haiku and Luna are Meta's own or Artificial Analysis estimates; real-world cost and reliability at scale will depend on actual token efficiency and integration quality.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Ember 瞄準代理 token 使用中佔比最高的重複子步驟，搭配較大 Muse 模型時可望降低多代理系統成本。相對於 Haiku 與 Luna 的基準主張來自 Meta 或 Artificial Analysis 估計；實際大規模成本與可靠性仍取決於真實 token 效率與整合品質。
items_flat.quote: Today, we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Muse Ember，這是我們最小且最高效的模型，專為複雜推理執行與代理整天重複的工作而設計。

items_flat.title_en: Google introduces TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max for confidential and high-context agentic AI
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 TPU 8tx 與 TPU 8i Max，專為機密與高上下文代理式 AI 設計
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced two new eighth-generation TPU systems on Nov 9: TPU 8tx for hardware-level confidential inference (paired with AMD EPYC hosts, keeping data and weights protected in use) and TPU 8i Max (dual TPU 8i chips in one package for double compute, SRAM and HBM bandwidth aimed at massive context windows). This brings four TPU systems in one year; TPUs are described as a growing business with nearly 100 customers. No public pricing or exact availability dates were given.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 於 11 月 9 日宣布兩款第八代 TPU 系統：TPU 8tx 提供硬體級機密推論（搭配 AMD EPYC 主機，在使用中保護資料與權重），以及 TPU 8i Max（單封裝雙 TPU 8i 晶片，運算、SRAM 與 HBM 頻寬倍增，瞄準超大上下文視窗）。這使今年推出四款 TPU 系統；TPU 被描述為擁有近 100 家客戶的成長業務。未公布公開定價或確切上市日期。
items_flat.analysis_en: This shows Google specializing infrastructure for agentic workloads where memory walls and confidential data matter, using modular packaging to ship faster than full chip cycles. Availability in 2027 and competitive pricing versus Nvidia remain open questions that will determine adoption beyond Google’s own stack.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這顯示 Google 針對記憶牆與機密資料重要的代理工作負載，專門化基礎設施，並以模組化封裝加速出貨。2027 年可用性與相對於 Nvidia 的競爭定價仍是開放問題，將決定其在 Google 自身堆疊之外的採用程度。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re taking that a step further, expanding our eighth-generation TPU portfolio with two additional systems: TPU 8i Max for massive context windows and the highest compute density per rack, and TPU 8tx for secure and confidential inference.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們再進一步，擴充第八代 TPU 產品組合，新增兩款系統：TPU 8i Max 專為超大上下文視窗與每機架最高運算密度設計，以及 TPU 8tx 專為安全機密推論。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI makes ChatGPT Enterprise available in AWS Marketplace
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將 ChatGPT Enterprise 上架 AWS Marketplace
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced on Nov 9 that ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace. Organizations can discover, buy and manage it via existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships, with eligible spend counting toward AWS commitments.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 11 月 9 日宣布 ChatGPT Enterprise 現已可透過 AWS Marketplace 取得。組織可透過既有 AWS 採購與帳單關係發現、購買並管理，符合資格的支出可計入 AWS 承諾。
items_flat.analysis_en: The listing lowers procurement friction for AWS-heavy enterprises and lets them apply committed cloud spend. It does not change the underlying product or guarantee that all customers will see material savings or feature parity versus direct OpenAI contracts.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此上架降低 AWS 重度企業的採購摩擦，並允許其運用已承諾的雲端支出。它並未改變底層產品，也不保證所有客戶相較直接 OpenAI 合約會有實質節省或功能對等。
items_flat.quote: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT Enterprise 現已可於 AWS Marketplace 取得

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces Control Room to rapidly halt research model workloads
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Control Room，可快速停止研究模型工作負載
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI posted on X and published a blog on Nov 9 that it built Control Room, a central system tracking every research inference workload—including agentic sampling for training and evaluation—and capable of halting model output within 35 seconds of a decision to intervene. It is already deployed on research infrastructure, designed to fail closed, and works with misalignment monitors.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 11 月 9 日在 X 發文並發布部落格，宣布已建立 Control Room，這是一套中央系統，追蹤所有研究推論工作負載（包括訓練與評估的代理採樣），並可在決定干預後 35 秒內停止模型輸出。它已部署於研究基礎設施，設計為失敗關閉，並與錯位監控系統配合。
items_flat.analysis_en: Faster, centralized kill switches address a practical gap as agentic research workloads grow. The 35-second figure is an internal claim stemming from caching; independent details on coverage, false-positive rates, and effectiveness against sophisticated misalignment remain limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更快、集中的停止開關填補了代理式研究工作負載成長下的實務缺口。35 秒數字是內部因快取而產生的主張；關於覆蓋範圍、誤報率以及對複雜錯位的有效性，獨立細節仍有限。
items_flat.quote: We built Control Room, a central system to track model workloads across our research infrastructure and stop them quickly when safety or security concerns arise.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們建立了 Control Room，這是一套中央系統，用以追蹤我們研究基礎設施中的模型工作負載，並在出現安全或資安疑慮時快速停止它們。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk says overnight Grok Bot fixes follow engineering roundtable
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk 表示與 Grok Bot 工程團隊圓桌後已連夜修復
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted on X on Nov 9 that he held a roundtable review with the Grok Bot engineering team, with fixes implemented overnight and users expected to notice a dramatic improvement by the next day. He invited replies for any remaining issues.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 於 11 月 9 日在 X 發文，表示已與 Grok Bot 工程團隊進行圓桌審查，修復已於隔夜實施，並預期使用者隔天會注意到明顯改善。他邀請回覆回報任何剩餘問題。
items_flat.analysis_en: Direct executive involvement signals rapid iteration on the agent product amid user feedback. Concrete changes and measured gains are not yet detailed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 高層直接參與顯示在使用者回饋下對代理產品的快速迭代。具體變更與量測到的改善尚未詳述。
items_flat.quote: Just did a round table review with the Grok @Bot engineering team. Fixes are being implemented overnight and you should notice a dramatic improvement by tomorrow.
items_flat.quote_zh: 剛與 Grok @Bot 工程團隊進行圓桌審查。修復正在隔夜實施，你應該明天會注意到明顯改善。

items_flat.title_en: Meta introduces Spaces in Muse for custom experiences built by description
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 在 Muse 推出 Spaces，可依描述打造自訂體驗
items_flat.summary_en: Meta launched Spaces in the Muse app on Nov 6, letting users describe an idea (e.g., holiday gift tracker, school dashboard) so Muse builds a custom interactive experience that can be pinned, scheduled and kept updated from connected apps.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 於 11 月 6 日在 Muse 應用程式推出 Spaces，讓使用者描述想法（例如節日禮物追蹤器、學校儀表板），由 Muse 打造可釘選、排程並從連接應用程式持續更新的自訂互動體驗。
items_flat.analysis_en: This turns the personal agent into a mini-app builder, reducing friction for routine tools. Success depends on reliability of background updates and data handling from third-party connectors.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將個人代理變成迷你應用程式建構器，降低日常工具的摩擦。成功取決於背景更新的可靠性以及第三方連接器的資料處理。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing spaces, an interactive way to build a more personalized Muse. A space is a custom experience you create inside Muse by describing your idea.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 spaces，一種以互動方式建立更個人化 Muse 的方式。Space 是你在 Muse 內以描述想法建立的自訂體驗。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral expands Studio with managed agents, workflows and enterprise apps
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 擴充 Studio，新增受管理代理、工作流程與企業應用
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral announced on Nov 5 an expansion of Studio with managed agents (skills, sandboxes, subagents, hooks), natural-language workflow builder (rules + agent reasoning + human approvals), and hosted apps with authentication and access controls.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 於 11 月 5 日宣布擴充 Studio，新增受管理代理（技能、沙盒、子代理、鉤子）、自然語言工作流程建構器（規則 + 代理推理 + 人工核准），以及具認證與存取控制的託管應用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This strengthens Mistral’s enterprise control story for sovereign AI deployments. Public preview status means production readiness and pricing details are still evolving.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這強化了 Mistral 在主權 AI 部署中的企業控制敘事。公開預覽狀態意味著生產就緒度與定價細節仍在演進中。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re expanding Studio with managed agents and apps, alongside new capabilities for workflows, enterprise context, agent observability and evaluations.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們擴充 Studio，新增管理式代理與應用，以及工作流、企業情境、代理可觀測性與評估的新能力。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic secures ~$3.4B deal for 1.7 GW of gas-fired generators, FT reports
items_flat.title_zh: 金融時報報導 Anthropic 取得約 34 億美元、1.7 GW 燃氣發電機協議
items_flat.summary_en: The Financial Times reported on Nov 8 that Anthropic struck a deal worth about $3.4 billion for commitments to 1.7 gigawatts of heavy-duty gas-fired generators from OnePWR Solutions to power data centers, including engineering and construction elements.
items_flat.summary_zh: 金融時報於 11 月 8 日報導，Anthropic 與 OnePWR Solutions 達成約 34 億美元協議，承諾取得 1.7 GW 重型燃氣發電機以供應資料中心電力，包含工程與建設要素。
items_flat.analysis_en: If confirmed, this accelerates Anthropic’s power capacity outside traditional grid timelines amid rising demand for Claude. Verification and long-term emissions or cost implications remain pending.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若屬實，這可在 Claude 需求上升之際，加速 Anthropic 在傳統電網時程之外的電力容量。驗證以及長期排放或成本影響仍待確認。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 發布國家社區契約與運算園區政策藍圖
items_flat.summary_en: On Nov 5 OpenAI published a National Community Compact for campuses it owns and operates (community input, published plans, full energy cost coverage, no NDAs with officials) and a Compute Campus Policy Blueprint urging policymakers to protect local interests while enabling AI infrastructure.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 11 月 5 日發布其擁有並營運園區的國家社區契約（社區意見、公開計畫、全額能源成本負擔、不與官員簽 NDA）以及運算園區政策藍圖，敦促政策制定者在保護地方利益的同時促進 AI 基礎設施。
items_flat.analysis_en: The commitments aim to ease local opposition while scaling compute. Scope is limited to owned-and-operated sites, leaving partner and leased capacity outside the pledges.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些承諾旨在降低地方反對的同時擴充運算。範圍僅限自有並營運的場址，夥伴與租賃容量不在承諾之內。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re publishing our National Community Compact and a Compute Campus Policy Blueprint. The compact sets out what communities can expect from OpenAI at future campuses that we own and operate.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們發布國家社區協定與運算園區政策藍圖。協定說明社區在 OpenAI 未來擁有營運的園區可期待什麼。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic secures ~$3.4B deal for 1.7 GW of gas-fired generators, FT reports
anthropic.title_zh: 金融時報報導 Anthropic 取得約 34 億美元、1.7 GW 燃氣發電機協議
anthropic.summary_en: The Financial Times reported on Nov 8 that Anthropic struck a deal worth about $3.4 billion for commitments to 1.7 gigawatts of heavy-duty gas-fired generators from OnePWR Solutions to power data centers, including engineering and construction elements.
anthropic.summary_zh: 金融時報於 11 月 8 日報導，Anthropic 與 OnePWR Solutions 達成約 34 億美元協議，承諾取得 1.7 GW 重型燃氣發電機以供應資料中心電力，包含工程與建設要素。
anthropic.analysis_en: If confirmed, this accelerates Anthropic’s power capacity outside traditional grid timelines amid rising demand for Claude. Verification and long-term emissions or cost implications remain pending.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 若屬實，這可在 Claude 需求上升之際，加速 Anthropic 在傳統電網時程之外的電力容量。驗證以及長期排放或成本影響仍待確認。

google.title_en: Google introduces TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max for confidential and high-context agentic AI
google.title_zh: Google 推出 TPU 8tx 與 TPU 8i Max，專為機密與高上下文代理式 AI 設計
google.summary_en: Google announced two new eighth-generation TPU systems on Nov 9: TPU 8tx for hardware-level confidential inference (paired with AMD EPYC hosts, keeping data and weights protected in use) and TPU 8i Max (dual TPU 8i chips in one package for double compute, SRAM and HBM bandwidth aimed at massive context windows). This brings four TPU systems in one year; TPUs are described as a growing business with nearly 100 customers. No public pricing or exact availability dates were given.
google.summary_zh: Google 於 11 月 9 日宣布兩款第八代 TPU 系統：TPU 8tx 提供硬體級機密推論（搭配 AMD EPYC 主機，在使用中保護資料與權重），以及 TPU 8i Max（單封裝雙 TPU 8i 晶片，運算、SRAM 與 HBM 頻寬倍增，瞄準超大上下文視窗）。這使今年推出四款 TPU 系統；TPU 被描述為擁有近 100 家客戶的成長業務。未公布公開定價或確切上市日期。
google.analysis_en: This shows Google specializing infrastructure for agentic workloads where memory walls and confidential data matter, using modular packaging to ship faster than full chip cycles. Availability in 2027 and competitive pricing versus Nvidia remain open questions that will determine adoption beyond Google’s own stack.
google.analysis_zh: 這顯示 Google 針對記憶牆與機密資料重要的代理工作負載，專門化基礎設施，並以模組化封裝加速出貨。2027 年可用性與相對於 Nvidia 的競爭定價仍是開放問題，將決定其在 Google 自身堆疊之外的採用程度。
google.quote: Today, we’re taking that a step further, expanding our eighth-generation TPU portfolio with two additional systems: TPU 8i Max for massive context windows and the highest compute density per rack, and TPU 8tx for secure and confidential inference.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們再進一步，擴充第八代 TPU 產品組合，新增兩款系統：TPU 8i Max 專為超大上下文視窗與每機架最高運算密度設計，以及 TPU 8tx 專為安全機密推論。

meta.title_en: Meta introduces Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model for agent workflows
meta.title_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Ember，專為代理工作流程設計的最小且最高效模型
meta.summary_en: Meta announced Muse Ember on Nov 9 as its smallest multimodal model built for high-volume agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing and document parsing. It offers a 1M-token context window, is priced at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens, and is available on the Meta Model API, Muse Code, and now Google Cloud. Meta positions it as matching Claude Haiku 5.5's best Intelligence Index score at roughly one-third the cost per task.
meta.summary_zh: Meta 於 11 月 9 日宣布 Muse Ember，這是其最小的多模態模型，專為高容量代理工作（工具呼叫、程式子任務、路由與文件解析）打造。具備 100 萬 token 上下文，定價為輸入每百萬 $0.10、輸出 $0.50，可於 Meta Model API、Muse Code 及現已上架 Google Cloud 使用。Meta 稱其在 Intelligence Index 上與 Claude Haiku 5.5 最佳分數相當，但每任務成本約為三分之一。
meta.analysis_en: Ember targets the repetitive sub-steps that dominate agent token usage, potentially lowering the cost of multi-agent systems when paired with larger Muse models. Benchmark claims versus Haiku and Luna are Meta's own or Artificial Analysis estimates; real-world cost and reliability at scale will depend on actual token efficiency and integration quality.
meta.analysis_zh: Ember 瞄準代理 token 使用中佔比最高的重複子步驟，搭配較大 Muse 模型時可望降低多代理系統成本。相對於 Haiku 與 Luna 的基準主張來自 Meta 或 Artificial Analysis 估計；實際大規模成本與可靠性仍取決於真實 token 效率與整合品質。
meta.quote: Today, we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day.
meta.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Muse Ember，這是我們最小且最高效的模型，專為複雜推理執行與代理整天重複的工作而設計。

meta.title_en: Meta introduces Spaces in Muse for custom experiences built by description
meta.title_zh: Meta 在 Muse 推出 Spaces，可依描述打造自訂體驗
meta.summary_en: Meta launched Spaces in the Muse app on Nov 6, letting users describe an idea (e.g., holiday gift tracker, school dashboard) so Muse builds a custom interactive experience that can be pinned, scheduled and kept updated from connected apps.
meta.summary_zh: Meta 於 11 月 6 日在 Muse 應用程式推出 Spaces，讓使用者描述想法（例如節日禮物追蹤器、學校儀表板），由 Muse 打造可釘選、排程並從連接應用程式持續更新的自訂互動體驗。
meta.analysis_en: This turns the personal agent into a mini-app builder, reducing friction for routine tools. Success depends on reliability of background updates and data handling from third-party connectors.
meta.analysis_zh: 這將個人代理變成迷你應用程式建構器，降低日常工具的摩擦。成功取決於背景更新的可靠性以及第三方連接器的資料處理。
meta.quote: Today, we’re introducing spaces, an interactive way to build a more personalized Muse. A space is a custom experience you create inside Muse by describing your idea.
meta.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 spaces，一種以互動方式建立更個人化 Muse 的方式。Space 是你在 Muse 內以描述想法建立的自訂體驗。

xai.title_en: Elon Musk says overnight Grok Bot fixes follow engineering roundtable
xai.title_zh: Elon Musk 表示與 Grok Bot 工程團隊圓桌後已連夜修復
xai.summary_en: Elon Musk posted on X on Nov 9 that he held a roundtable review with the Grok Bot engineering team, with fixes implemented overnight and users expected to notice a dramatic improvement by the next day. He invited replies for any remaining issues.
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk 於 11 月 9 日在 X 發文，表示已與 Grok Bot 工程團隊進行圓桌審查，修復已於隔夜實施，並預期使用者隔天會注意到明顯改善。他邀請回覆回報任何剩餘問題。
xai.analysis_en: Direct executive involvement signals rapid iteration on the agent product amid user feedback. Concrete changes and measured gains are not yet detailed.
xai.analysis_zh: 高層直接參與顯示在使用者回饋下對代理產品的快速迭代。具體變更與量測到的改善尚未詳述。
xai.quote: Just did a round table review with the Grok @Bot engineering team. Fixes are being implemented overnight and you should notice a dramatic improvement by tomorrow.
xai.quote_zh: 剛與 Grok @Bot 工程團隊進行圓桌審查。修復正在隔夜實施，你應該明天會注意到明顯改善。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral expands Studio with managed agents, workflows and enterprise apps
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral 擴充 Studio，新增受管理代理、工作流程與企業應用
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral announced on Nov 5 an expansion of Studio with managed agents (skills, sandboxes, subagents, hooks), natural-language workflow builder (rules + agent reasoning + human approvals), and hosted apps with authentication and access controls.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral 於 11 月 5 日宣布擴充 Studio，新增受管理代理（技能、沙盒、子代理、鉤子）、自然語言工作流程建構器（規則 + 代理推理 + 人工核准），以及具認證與存取控制的託管應用。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This strengthens Mistral’s enterprise control story for sovereign AI deployments. Public preview status means production readiness and pricing details are still evolving.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這強化了 Mistral 在主權 AI 部署中的企業控制敘事。公開預覽狀態意味著生產就緒度與定價細節仍在演進中。
frontier_other.quote: Today, we’re expanding Studio with managed agents and apps, alongside new capabilities for workflows, enterprise context, agent observability and evaluations.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今天，我們擴充 Studio，新增管理式代理與應用，以及工作流、企業情境、代理可觀測性與評估的新能力。

brief_en: Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 (same model, different safeguards) with 20% price cut and strong coding/science gains. Meta launches efficient Muse Ember for agent subtasks at $0.10/M input; Google expands TPU 8tx/8i Max for confidential and high-context inference. OpenAI deploys Control Room kill-switch and lists ChatGPT Enterprise on AWS Marketplace.
brief_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2（同一模型不同防護），降價 20% 並強化程式與科學能力。Meta 發布高效 Muse Ember 供代理子任務使用（輸入 $0.10/M）；Google 擴充 TPU 8tx/8i Max 以支援機密與高上下文推論。OpenAI 部署 Control Room 快速停止機制，並將 ChatGPT Enterprise 上架 AWS Marketplace。
